lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete clusters of high-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns on the anterior-mid flank, transitioning to a dense, stochastic distribution of smaller spots in the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear ridge running horizontally along the superior lateral margin, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity dorsal pixels to low-intensity sub-ridge shadow.
